title: CPU usage above 90% on checkout
root_cause: A runaway regex in the coupon validator backtracked on long coupon codes and burned CPU
resolution: Replaced the regex with a bounded parser and capped coupon code length

title: Payments CPU saturated by fraud scoring
root_cause: The fraud model was switched to a larger version that ran inline in the payments request path
resolution: Moved fraud scoring to an async worker and set a CPU budget for inline checks

title: Disk usage above 85% on metrics host
root_cause: Retention job had been failing silently for nine days
resolution: Fixed the retention job and alerted on its last successful run
